expected: Quantum computers will one day forge the signatures that guard every crypto wallet today. Magen is a wallet built for that day. Get it for iPhone, or as a Chrome extension.
transcript: Quantum computers will one day forge the signatures that guard every crypto wallet today. Magen is a wallet built for that day. Get it for iPhone or as a Chrome extension.

expected: Install it on the iPhone, and open it.
transcript: Install it on the iPhone and open it.

expected: Create a wallet. Pick a name. Then twelve words: your one backup. They stay hidden until you choose to see them.
transcript: Create a wallet, pick a name, then 12 words, your one backup. They stay hidden until you choose to see them.

expected: Those twelve words make your address on Bitcoin, Zcash, Ethereum, Solana and more, plus a quantum safe key, M L D S A sixty five.
transcript: Those 12 words make your address on Bitcoin, Zcash, Ethereum, Solana, and more, plus a quantum safe key, MLDS65.

expected: Creating the account is one transaction. Review it, and approve.
transcript: Creating the account is one transaction. Review it and approve.

expected: Your wallet is live on Near testnet, with two locks: your classical key, and the quantum safe one.
transcript: Your wallet is live on near testnet with two locks, your classical key and the quantum safe one.

expected: Receive on any chain. Here is Near, and here is Bitcoin, each with its own Q R code.
transcript: Receive on any chain, here is near and here is Bitcoin, each with its own QR code.

expected: Now send half a Near. The approval sheet shows everything, and it is signed twice: classical, and quantum safe.
transcript: Now send half a near, the approval sheet shows everything and it is signed twice, classical and quantum safe.

expected: On the explorer, the signer key is the quantum safe one, and the wallet contract logged both signatures as verified.
transcript: On the Explorer, the signer key is the quantum safe one, and the wallet contract logged both signatures as verified.

expected: Swap one Near for U S D T on Ref Finance. Four calls, one approval, two signatures.
transcript: Swap one near for USDT on REF Finance. Four calls, one approval, two signatures.

expected: Ref paid out one point two four U S D T.
transcript: REF paid out 1.24 USDT.

expected: Bring Bitcoin in. This is the wallet's own Bitcoin deposit address, made on chain by the bridge.
transcript: Bring Bitcoin in. This is the wallet's own Bitcoin deposit address, made on chain by the bridge.

expected: A new wallet starts empty. So here is our demo wallet, with two real deposits, each minted as n B T C on Near.
transcript: A new wallet starts empty, so here is our demo wallet with two real deposits, each minted as NBTC on near.

expected: The mint on Near, and the Bitcoin payment it came from, sent earlier from a testnet wallet.
transcript: The mint on near and the Bitcoin payment it came from sent earlier from a testnet wallet.

expected: Zcash works the same way. A testnet deposit became n Z E C on Near.
transcript: Zcash works the same way. A testnet deposit became NZEC on near.

expected: Bridge out, to this wallet's own Solana address, through the Omni bridge. Same approval, same two signatures.
transcript: Bridge out to this wallet's own Solana address through the Omni Bridge. Same approval, same two signatures.

expected: The bridge relays it. About a minute later, it has arrived on Solana.
transcript: The bridge relays it. About a minute later, it has arrived on Solana.

expected: Signed on NEAR testnet, then delivered on Solana devnet.
transcript: signed on near testnet, then delivered on Solana DevNet.

expected: Private send. The money goes to a one time account only the recipient can open. Signed twice, like everything else.
transcript: Private Send, the money goes to a one-time account only the recipient can open, signed twice like everything else.

expected: Add guardians. Two of three can help you recover the wallet, and none of them can ever spend.
transcript: Add Guardians, two of three can help you recover the wallet, and none of them can ever spend.

expected: The guardians are saved on chain, and Near checked both signatures.
transcript: The guardians are saved on chain and near-checked both signatures.

expected: And the Q Day switch. One transaction makes your quantum safe key a native Near key. Same account, same balance.
transcript: and the Q-Day switch, one transaction makes your quantum safe key a native near key. Same account, same balance.

expected: The account on NEAR now lists an M L D S A key.
transcript: The account on near now lists an MLDS key.

expected: Activity keeps every move, each one linked to the explorer.
transcript: Activity keeps every move, each one linked to the Explorer.

expected: And Magen locks itself, behind Face I D.
transcript: and Magen locks itself behind Face ID.

expected: One seed. Every chain. A quantum safe lock on every move. That's Magen.
transcript: One seed, every chain. A quantum safe lock on every move. That's Magen.
